title: A2A Authentication Schemes
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of authentication schemes for Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, covering both client-side request authentication and server-side token validation. It supports various methods including API keys, bearer tokens, HTTP Basic/Digest, and different OAuth2 flows.

nodes.label: Apply API Key Authentication
nodes.title: API Key Authentication (Client)
nodes.description: Manages API key authentication for outgoing requests, supporting header, query, or cookie locations.

nodes.label: Apply Bearer Token Authentication
nodes.title: Bearer Token Authentication (Client)
nodes.description: Handles Bearer token authentication by adding the token to the Authorization header for outgoing requests.

nodes.label: Apply HTTP Basic Authentication
nodes.title: HTTP Basic Authentication (Client)
nodes.description: Implements HTTP Basic authentication, encoding username and password for the Authorization header.

nodes.label: Apply HTTP Digest Authentication
nodes.title: HTTP Digest Authentication (Client)
nodes.description: Provides HTTP Digest authentication, configuring the HTTP client to handle the challenge-response flow.

nodes.label: Handle OAuth2 Client Credentials
nodes.title: OAuth2 Client Credentials (Client)
nodes.description: Manages OAuth2 Client Credentials flow, fetching and refreshing access tokens from an OAuth2 provider.

nodes.label: Handle OAuth2 Authorization Code
nodes.title: OAuth2 Authorization Code (Client)
nodes.description: Handles OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, including user interaction for authorization and token refreshing.

nodes.label: Validate Simple Bearer Token
nodes.title: Simple Bearer Token Auth (Server)
nodes.description: Validates incoming requests against a static bearer token, typically configured via environment variables.

nodes.label: Validate OIDC JWT
nodes.title: OIDC JWT Validation (Server)
nodes.description: Authenticates incoming JWTs using OpenID Connect (OIDC) by validating signatures against JWKS endpoints and checking claims.

nodes.label: Validate OAuth2 Token
nodes.title: OAuth2 Token Validation (Server)
nodes.description: Provides flexible OAuth2 token validation for incoming requests, supporting both JWT validation via JWKS and opaque token introspection.

nodes.label: Validate API Key
nodes.title: API Key Authentication (Server)
nodes.description: Validates incoming API keys found in headers, query parameters, or cookies against a configured expected value.

nodes.label: Handle mTLS Authentication
nodes.title: mTLS Authentication (Server)
nodes.description: Acts as a marker for Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication, indicating that client certificate validation is handled at the transport layer.

nodes.label: Validate Enterprise Token
nodes.title: Enterprise Token Authentication (Server)
nodes.description: Authenticates incoming tokens by verifying them against an external enterprise verification service, such as PlusAPI.

nodes.label: Retry Request on 401
nodes.title: Retry on 401 Utility
nodes.description: Utility function that retries an HTTP request if it fails with a 401 Unauthorized status, attempting to refresh authentication credentials.

nodes.label: External Service/API
nodes.title: External Service/API
nodes.description: Any external API or service that requires authentication for access.

nodes.label: OAuth2 Provider
nodes.title: OAuth2 Provider
nodes.description: An external service responsible for issuing and managing OAuth2 tokens.

nodes.label: JWKS Endpoint
nodes.title: JWKS Endpoint
nodes.description: A public endpoint providing JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS) for verifying JWT signatures.

nodes.label: OAuth2 Introspection Endpoint
nodes.title: OAuth2 Introspection Endpoint
nodes.description: An OAuth2 endpoint used to determine the active state and metadata of an opaque access token.

nodes.label: Enterprise PlusAPI
nodes.title: Enterprise PlusAPI
nodes.description: An internal or external enterprise service used for validating specific enterprise-level authentication tokens.

nodes.label: User/Browser
nodes.title: User/Browser Interaction
nodes.description: Represents the user agent or browser involved in interactive OAuth2 authorization flows.

groups.label: Client Authentication Schemes
groups.title: Client Authentication Schemes
groups.description: Components responsible for authenticating outgoing requests to external services.

groups.label: Server Authentication Schemes
groups.title: Server Authentication Schemes
groups.description: Components responsible for validating authentication credentials on incoming requests.

groups.label: Authentication Utilities
groups.title: Authentication Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions for managing authentication flows, such as retrying failed requests.
